'''Cryptosis''' is an [[NPC]] located in the {{zone|Village Plaza}}. They sell "BZT" in exchange for {{Item|Scribe Crux|amount=15}}es and {{Motes|15,000}}, which grants the player an {{Item|Enigma Soul}} when purchased.
